opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions in the UK undertaking internationally competitive research.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research, and sometimes to improve access and research libraries or public engagement with science. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority operating a fully accredited museum or gallery holding a permanent collection of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education and learning spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance that are open and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at historic buildings, landscapes, parks and gardens of national significance.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority operating a fully accredited library or archive holding a permanent collection of national significance and open to the public.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces for libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority focused on professional performance, with the performing arts constituting the vast majority of its activities.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve training and education facilities for performing arts organisations, generally towards building or refurbishing these facilities and occasionally specialist equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority working with disability, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to projects helping people with disabilities live more independently, particularly focusing on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority working in mental health, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted where applicable.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for charities working in mental health, with an emphasis on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority providing care and services for older people, particularly those with a neurodegenerative condition or who are isolated.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS providing excellent care to patients and their families.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for hospices and palliative care organisations.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education and learning spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to projects supporting pupils at secondary level to develop skills to gain employment or live independently after school or college.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Maximum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: High-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve the teaching at GCSE and A-Level of subjects needing specialist spaces and equipment (science, computer science, design & technology, art, languages, music and performing arts). One-stage application process. 2026 round closed; next round expected in spring 2027.
